Document: Loads the document at `url`, a local file path or `file:` URL pointing to a document in any format supported by Collabora.
saveAs: Saves the document to `url` in the given `format`. If `format` is omitted, it is inferred from the extension of `url`. `options` is a comma-separated string of filter options forwarded to Collabora; see the Collabora documentation for the filters available for a given format.
